messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — High error rate and latency on inference gateway. Alerts triggered for /v1/embeddings (5xx spike) and elevated p95 for /v1/chat. Paging on-call.
erica (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. seeing 502/503 from the embeddings modelpool (gpux-emb-01..03) and chat queue depth up ~4x.
sahil (infra): I'm pulling logs from the gateway and modelpool. Looks like a sudden flood of large-batch embedding requests from a single API key hitting 10k/min. Routing backlog is causing chat tails.
erica (oncall): Good find — sounds like a hot client. Priority mitigation: rate-limit that key and apply per-route soft quota for embeddings and rerank. We want to protect chat and interactive latency.
ryan (pm): Who's owning customer comms? If it's a heavy user we need CS on standby.
alex (cs): I'll check top customers and prepare a template. If it's over our SLA, we need to notify.
erica (oncall): Actions I'm going to take now: 1) apply per-endpoint throttle for embeddings 2) disable rerank route for 15m (to reduce downstream load) 3) add a temporary route-specific rate cap to protect chat.
sahil (infra): Ready to run the gateway change. Proposed commands:
```bash
# throttle the offending API key (id: ak_live_9a7)
redwoodctl auth revoke-rate --key ak_live_9a7 --limit 500/min

# set route-level soft limit for embeddings to 800/min globally
redwoodctl gateway set-quota --route /v1/embeddings --limit 800/min --scope global

# disable rerank route (will return 503 with informative body so clients can fallback)
redwoodctl gateway toggle-route --route /v1/rerank --state disabled --reason "mitigation: protect modelpool"
```
deploy-bot: exec: redwoodctl gateway set-quota --route /v1/embeddings --limit 800/min --scope global 
deploy-bot: OK — quota applied (txn 0x7f4)
sahil (infra): exec: redwoodctl auth revoke-rate --key ak_live_9a7 --limit 500/min
sahil (infra): OK — key throttled, returning 429 for excess requests.
erica (oncall): exec: redwoodctl gateway toggle-route --route /v1/rerank --state disabled
deploy-bot: OK — /v1/rerank responses now 503 (soft-disable)
mike (sre): Observability: queues are draining, chat p95 dropping back toward normal. Embedding errors decreased ~70% since throttle. Good.
erica (oncall): Next: apply a route-specific low-priority limit for embeddings to preserve burst for premium customers. Proposal: keep global 800/min but add per-API-key baseline of 50/min (soft) except keys in allowlist.
sahil (infra): I can push a per-key policy:
```bash
redwoodctl gateway set-per-key-quota --route /v1/embeddings --default 50/min --allowlist ak_premium_*
```
sahil (infra): Done. deploy-bot: applied per-key baseline quota.
ryan (pm): Any customers currently hitting the baseline and will be affected? alex?
alex (cs): Quick scan — two major customers (acme-inc and lexicon.ai) are above baseline but both are on premium keys (ak_premium_*), so they are allowlisted and unaffected. I'll still open a proactive support note to ACME.
erica (oncall): Handoff: mike, I'll be taking a 20m break — can you own the on-call and keep watching charts? Summary: throttled offending key ak_live_9a7, applied global embeddings quota 800/min, set per-key baseline 50/min with premium allowlist, disabled /v1/rerank. Chat latency improving.
mike (sre): Got it, taking over. I'll keep the incident active until we confirm stable for 1 hour.
erica (oncall): Filing incident ticket INC-2321 with timeline and customer impact. Key notes in ticket: embeddings client flood, rate-limited at 12:23 UTC, rerank disabled at 12:24 UTC, collections: logs, heap profiles, modelpool health checks attached.
alex (cs): Drafted outbound to top impacted customers — will wait for PM OK before sending.
ryan (pm): OK to send to ACME and Lexicon with note that premium unaffected and mitigations applied. Mike/Erica please paste a short summary I can use.
mike (sre): Summary for CS: "We observed a sudden spike of high-volume embedding requests from a single non-prem API key causing backend saturation and elevated chat latency. We throttled the key, placed a global embeddings quota, and temporarily disabled rerank to restore performance. Primary functionality (chat) is now stabilized; embeddings may be rate-limited for non-prem customers while we complete a deeper postmortem."
erica (oncall): :thumbsup: I'll add a quick graph and attach to the ticket.
mike (sre): Oncall note: if errors spike again, we escalate to infra to scale modelpool and to product to consider longer-term per-route quotas or auto-throttling heuristics.
sahil (infra): Followups I'm taking: 1) root-cause: check upstream client behavior and payload sizes 2) capacity: examine modelpool autoscale options 3) make per-route fallback path (lightweight embedding model) a runbook item.
erica (oncall): Thanks all. I'll mark the channel for handoff and set a reminder for a 1-hr check-in. Incident remains open; next update in 30m or on any regression.
incident-bot: Incident note added to INC-2321. Paging cleared for erica (oncall).
